Overview.Name: Thanneeru Rakesh
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable upma (small bowl)
Option 3: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & sautéed spinach
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & grilled chicken (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & dal (1 bowl) & bottle gourd curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & fish fry (pan fried) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Chicken stir fry with vegetables (light portion)
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (80 g paneer) & clear vegetable soup
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & cucumber salad

Notes_and_Tips: Because of diabetes and hypertension, keep rice portions smaller and make protein the main part of the plate.
Avoid deep fried snacks; choose pan fried chicken, fish or eggs to manage savory cravings.
Stress eating: drink water and wait 5 minutes before choosing snacks.
Regular protein intake will help reduce belly fat and improve body shape.
Keep meal timings consistent to support thyroid balance and stable energy.
